lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice reporting a simple message with sa att.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A colleague passes on a practical message about lunch, fika, or a plan.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Relaying what someone said in a simple everyday way.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk after one of them heard that a time, lunch place, or small plan has changed.

main_focus.name: reported speech with sa att
main_focus.description: Use sa att to report a simple message without changing tense unnecessarily.
model_examples: Hon sa att lunchen börjar halv tolv.
Han sa att han inte kan komma idag.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use sa att naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: inte before verb in subordinate clauses

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical message words around time, plans, or lunch.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person shares that a simple message has come in.
dialogue_shape.middle: They report the message and clarify what it means for the plan.
dialogue_shape.ending: They adjust their plan or acknowledge the information.

target_complexity.repetition: use a few sa att clauses but keep them short

focus: how the plan is adjusted after the message

sentence_focus: one sentence with hon sa att
one sentence with han sa att
one sentence with jag hörde att
one sentence with inte in an att-clause
one sentence explaining a changed time or plan
